response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack engineering experience, open-source contributions, and exposure to agentic workflows and event-driven systems, but lacks clear evidence of leading AI systems in regulated fintech environments, scaling engineering teams to 30+, or designing multi-agent frameworks with financial risk constraints — critical for this CTO role.
strengths: Hands-on experience with agentic workflows and MCP frameworks at re:cinq
Proven track record in event-driven, distributed systems (e.g., GISCollective, Dunnhumby)
Strong engineering culture advocacy via TDD, CI/CD, and knowledge sharing
concerns: No demonstrable experience in fintech infrastructure, credit risk, or regulatory compliance
Lacks evidence of scaling teams beyond 10–15 people or building senior technical leadership layers
No mention of LLM evaluation pipelines, real-time inference systems, or model-agnostic AI architecture
